aitGreen.role: Primary. Headlines, logo green, primary actions.

lime.role: Emphasis. Backgrounds and large headline type. Never small text on white.

sage.role: Subtle accent and large decorative type. Never small text on white.

darkGrey.role: Body text, secondary UI, quiet backgrounds.

lightGrey.role: Hairlines and disabled fills. Never small text.

interface.note: Interface neutrals and the danger color are product utilities. They are outside the five-color AIT signature palette.

display.use: Product name, page titles, section headings.

signature.use: Email signatures only, per AIT visual identity.

identifier.use: UIN, request ids, and other fixed-width identifiers. Product exception, not an AIT brand face.

logo.assetPolicy: Use official files from the Office of Public Affairs. Do not redraw, recolor, or commit a reconstructed globe.
logo.clearSpace: Width of the capital A in the primary logo, on all sides.

productLockup.name: register-id
productLockup.rule: Set the product name in Metropolis beside or under the official AIT logo. Keep the institute logo intact and separate.
